title: RGS/Q6 discrete U(1) Bianchi audit

conventions.cube_boundary: dF = Δ_a F_bc - Δ_b F_ac + Δ_c F_ab
conventions.cube_integer_charge: m = oriented sum of principal plaquette angles divided by 2π
conventions.warning: Nonzero integer charge is a compact-angle/branch defect candidate, not by itself a physical monopole.

interpretation: Compact U(1) Bianchi identity holds on every 3-cube modulo 2π.
Principal plaquette angles produce nonzero integer cube charges on some cubes because of the principal branch.
The integer charges form a closed integer cochain: their oriented boundary vanishes on every 4-cube.
No continuum magnetic monopole, continuum Bianchi equation, or physical source is established.
